refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Resolve.Monitor is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.Resolve.Monitor
type DNSProtocol( # DNS dns, # Multicast DNS mdns, # LLMNR llmnr )
type DNSOverTLSMode( # DNSOverTLS is disabled. no, # DNSOverTLS is enabled. yes, # Try to use DNSOverTLS, but disabled when the server does not support it. opportunistic )
type ResolveSupport( # The protocol is disabled. no, # The protocol is enabled. yes, # The protocol is used only for resolving. resolve )
type ResolvConfMode( # /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf. uplink, # /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf. stub, # /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /usr/lib/systemd/resolv.conf. static, # /etc/resolv.conf does not exist. missing, # /etc/resolv.conf is not managed by systemd-resolved. foreign )
type ResourceKey( # The RR class, almost always IN, i.e 0x01. If unspecified defaults to IN. class: ?int, # The RR types, one of A, AAAA, PTR, … type: int, # The domain name. name: string )
type ResourceRecord( key: ResourceKey, priority: ?int, weight: ?int, port: ?int, name: ?string, cpu: ?string, os: ?string, items: ?[]string, address: ?[]int, mname: ?string, rname: ?string, serial: ?int, refresh: ?int, retry: ?int, expire: ?int, minimum: ?int, exchange: ?string, version: ?int, size: ?int, horiz_pre: ?int, vert_pre: ?int, latitude: ?int, longitude: ?int, altitude: ?int, keyTag: ?int, algorithm: ?int, digestType: ?int, digest: ?string, fptype: ?int, fingerprint: ?string, flags: ?int, protocol: ?int, dnskey: ?string, signer: ?string, typeCovered: ?int, labels: ?int, originalTtl: ?int, expiration: ?int, inception: ?int, signature: ?string, nextDomain: ?string, types: ?[]int, iterations: ?int, salt: ?string, hash: ?string, certUsage: ?int, selector: ?int, matchingType: ?int, data: ?string, tag: ?string, value: ?string, target: ?string, svcparams: ?object, order: ?int, preference: ?int, naptrFlags: ?string, services: ?string, regexp: ?string, replacement: ?string )
type ResourceRecordArray( rr: ?ResourceRecord, raw: string )
type Answer( rr: ?ResourceRecord, raw: string, ifindex: ?int )
type CacheEntry( key: ResourceKey, rrs: ?[]ResourceRecordArray, type: ?string, until: int )
type ScopeCache( protocol: DNSProtocol, family: ?int, ifindex: ?int, ifname: ?string, cache: []CacheEntry, dnssec: ?string, dnsOverTLS: ?DNSOverTLSMode )
type TransactionStatistics( currentTransactions: int, totalTransactions: int, totalTimeouts: int, totalTimeoutsServedStale: int, totalFailedResponses: int, totalFailedResponsesServedStale: int )
type CacheStatistics( size: int, hits: int, misses: int )
type DnssecStatistics( secure: int, insecure: int, bogus: int, indeterminate: int )
type ServerState( Server: string, Type: string, Interface: ?string, InterfaceIndex: ?int, VerifiedFeatureLevel: string, PossibleFeatureLevel: string, DNSSECMode: string, DNSSECSupported: bool, ReceivedUDPFragmentMax: int, FailedUDPAttempts: int, FailedTCPAttempts: int, PacketTruncated: bool, PacketBadOpt: bool, PacketRRSIGMissing: bool, PacketInvalid: bool, PacketDoOff: bool )
# Encapsulates a DNS server address specification. type DNSServer( # IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server. address: []int, # IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server, formatted as a human-readable string. addressString: ?string, # Address family of the server, one of AF_INET or AF_INET6. family: int, # Port number of the server. port: int, # Interface index for which this server is configured. ifindex: ?int, # Server Name Indication (SNI) of the server. name: ?string, # Indicates if the DNS server is accessible or not. accessible: bool )
# Encapsulates a search domain specification. type SearchDomain( # Domain name. name: string, # Indicates whether or not this is a routing-only domain. routeOnly: bool, # Interface index for which this search domain is configured. ifindex: ?int )
# Encapsulates a global or per-link DNS configuration, including configured DNS servers, search domains, and more. type DNSConfiguration( # Interface name, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global configuration. ifname: ?string, # Interface index, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global configuration. ifindex: ?int, # Delegate name, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global or link configurations. delegate: ?string, # Indicates whether or not this link's DNS servers will be used for resolving domain names that do not match any link's configured domains. defaultRoute: ?bool, # DNS server currently selected to use for lookups. currentServer: ?DNSServer, # Array of configured DNS servers. servers: ?[]DNSServer, # Array of configured fallback DNS servers, set for global configuration only. fallbackServers: ?[]DNSServer, # Array of configured search domains. searchDomains: ?[]SearchDomain, # Array of configured DNSSEC negative trust anchors. negativeTrustAnchors: ?[]string, # DNSSEC mode. dnssec: ?string, # Indicates if the current DNS server supports DNSSEC. Always false if DNSSEC mode is "no". dnssecSupported: ?bool, # DNSOverTLS mode. dnsOverTLS: ?DNSOverTLSMode, # LLMNR support. llmnr: ?string, # mDNS support. mDNS: ?ResolveSupport, # resolv.conf mode, set for global configuration only. resolvConfMode: ?ResolvConfMode, # Array of current DNS scopes. scopes: ?[]DNSScope )
# Encapsulates a DNS scope specification. type DNSScope( # Protocol associated with this scope. protocol: DNSProtocol, # Address family associated with this scope. family: ?int, # Interface index associated with this scope. ifindex: ?int, # Interface name associated with this scope. ifname: ?string, # DNSSEC mode associated with this scope. dnssec: ?string, # DNSOverTLS mode associated with this scope. dnsOverTLS: ?DNSOverTLSMode )
# [Requires 'more' flag] method SubscribeQueryResults( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( ready: ?bool, state: ?string, result: ?string, rcode: ?int, errno: ?int, extendedDNSErrorCode: ?int, extendedDNSErrorMessage: ?string, question: ?[]ResourceKey, collectedQuestions: ?[]ResourceKey, answer: ?[]Answer )
method DumpCache( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( dump: []ScopeCache )
method DumpServerState( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( dump: []ServerState )
method DumpStatistics( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( transactions: TransactionStatistics, cache: CacheStatistics, dnssec: DnssecStatistics )
method ResetStatistics( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sends the complete global and per-link DNS configurations when any changes are made to them. The current configurations are given immediately when this method is invoked. # [Requires 'more' flag] method SubscribeDNSConfiguration( allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # The current global and per-interface DNS configurations configuration: []DNSConfiguration )
# Flushes all DNS resource record caches the service maintains locally. method FlushCaches( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Flushes all feature level information the resolver learnt about specific servers, and ensures that the server feature probing logic is started from the beginning with the next look-up request. method ResetServerFeatures( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Resolve.Monitor shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Resolve.Monitor.SubscribeQueryResults '{}' invokes its SubscribeQueryResults() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Resolve.Monitor interface was added in version 254.

Answer, CacheEntry, CacheStatistics, DnssecStatistics, DumpCache(), DumpServerState(), DumpStatistics(), ResetStatistics(), ResourceKey, ResourceRecord, ScopeCache, ServerState, SubscribeQueryResults(), and TransactionStatistics were added in version 254.
DNSConfiguration, DNSServer, SearchDomain, and SubscribeDNSConfiguration() were added in version 258.
DNSOverTLSMode, DNSProtocol, DNSScope, ResolvConfMode, and ResolveSupport were added in version 259.
FlushCaches(), and ResetServerFeatures() were added in version 262.
